title: VCAT mismatch index row
description: One locus id found in ZL or IT (roadmap item 1.8): both raw texts, both readings under the named comparison profile, and the verdict of vcat.comparison.compare. No consensus reading (principle 4).

line_number.description: The locus number of the identifier

line_id.description: {page_id}:{line_number}, the key shared with the EVA lines dataset

status.description: identical: the two text_raw are equal; same_reading: the profile's word sequences are equal (. , and drawing breaks all separate words); alternate_reading: equal for some choice among the alternates; different: none of these; zl_only or it_only: one source has no such locus

comparison_profile.description: The normalization profile both texts are read through (vcat.profiles), e.g. analysis-v1

zl_text_raw.description: ZL's text_raw, byte for byte, or null

it_text_raw.description: IT's text_raw, byte for byte, or null

zl_reading.description: ZL's text under the comparison profile

it_reading.description: IT's text under the comparison profile

zl_source_line.description: The line of the locus identifier in ZL3b-n.txt

it_source_line.description: The line of the locus identifier in IT_ivtff_1a.txt

similarity_score.description: difflib ratio of the two first-reading word sequences; a description, never the verdict

sources_present.description: Which of the five sources ZL, IT, CD, FG and GC hold this locus id; the other cached sources are not evaluated, so their absence here says nothing
